{{Quote|CT-1284, Spark, reporting for duty, sir!|Spark, to [[Blackout/Legends|Blackout]]|<ref name="CaM" />}}
'''Spark''', also identified with the number '''CT-1284''', was a rookie [[Special ops clone trooper/Legends|stealth operations clone trooper]] assigned to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] towards the middle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], Spark crewed the [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]] under the watch of [[Blackout/Legends|Blackout]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Spark, under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Yularen]], and [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Blackout/Legends|Blackout]] crewed the stealth ship to travel to [[Christophsis]] on a supply run, to aid [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. However, they ended up fighting against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Fleet]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]]. Later, Skywalker and the rest of the crew defeated Trench.<ref name="CaM" />
